title: rhobound-mcp.budget/v1
description: The `budget` tool (ARCHITECTURE.md 4.7, 5.5): how much a service may add per visit. The root validates the view `rhobound budget --fit F [--service S] [--policy P] --json` prints (canonical JSON); the server adds only its own keys. $defs/input is the tool's input schema. max_value is the largest x with change(x) <= T at every entry; safe_value the largest x with change(x) + model band(x) <= T, both by bisection (at most 25 solves each), never x_max minus a band.

kinds.description: extra_calls needs the structural patch; refused until it ships

policy.description: a policy name from server configuration

max_value.description: largest x with change(x) <= T at every entry

safe_value.description: largest x with change(x) + model band(x) <= T at every entry (4.7)

binding_constraint.description: max_utilization_validated binds load_scale only: the factor is capped at the validated load

assumes.description: always includes 'monotone entry mean in the added quantity (untested)' until the simulator test passes

findings.description: budget.no_policy (doubt) when no policy applies: no entry threshold binds, only the utilization limits, so max_value can be many times what a policy allows; absent under a policy

truncated.description: true when more than 40 items existed; the 40 kept are those with the highest leverage
